These 2.0–2.2 mm rocailles are rated for everyday wear, making them a solid choice for woven bracelets, loom work, and peyote or brick stitch pieces where the beads take real friction; the muted, ceramic-like finish also reads beautifully in embroidered textile work and fiber art where you want color without high shine.
